title: DevExp sprint lighthouse notes - June 21 2026
body:
Meeting: DevExp weekly sprint 'Lighthouse' check-in
Date: 2026-06-21
Facilitator: Priya Raman
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, María, Samir, Jin, (saw read receipts from: Claire, Ben)

1) Quick summary / goal for the week
- Focus: reduce onboarding friction for new SDK users by (a) trimming quickstart surface area, (b) stabilizing 3 sample apps, (c) adding targeted telemetry for first-10-min flows.
- Success metric: 15% uplift in quickstart completion (instrumented conversion funnel) and <5m median time-to-first-success on local sample run.

2) Highlights / progress since last check
- SDK: Ethan merged hotfix for credential refresh edge-case (GH PR #4321). This fixes intermittent 401s when environment variables are set alongside a credentials file. Verified with local e2e.
- Quickstarts: María completed the new reduced quickstart README (single page, minimal deps). Draft located in Confluence quickstarts doc linked above.
- Samples: Samir pushed updated sample-app-embed flow; sample now uses streaming + basic error fallback. CI flake reduced from ~18% -> ~6% on the sample-run suite.
- Telemetry: Jin implemented first-10-min funnel events in the playground: quickstart_started, sample_run_first_token, sample_run_success. Events are visible in Amplitude staging.

3) Current blockers and open questions
- Local reproducibility: some Windows users still see the sample app crash on startup (stack trace points at electron native module load). Needs Windows-specific pipeline to reproduce. Owner: Samir. ETA: 06/25.
- Docs copy: We need a short blurb for the billing/limits section in the quickstart to prevent confusion around token quotas for free accounts. Owner: María + product ops.
- Telemetry privacy: Legal asked for a short description of what the first-10-min events capture and retention policy. Jin to draft and send to privacy/legal by 06/23.

4) Decisions made in this meeting
- Ship the trimmed quickstart as an opt-in beta (feat flag in console) next Wed (06/30). Rationale: reduces risk while letting us measure the funnel.
- Turn on streaming by default in the embedded sample app unless user toggles it off. Streaming improves perceived latency and we have fallback in place.

5) Action items (owner - due)
- Samir - Create reproducible Windows minimal repro + open a Windows-specific ticket with steps and logs (due 2026-06-25).
- Ethan - Cut a patch release for SDK 0.12.3 with the credential refresh fix and update release notes (due 2026-06-23). Link to PR in linear when cut.
- María - Finalize quickstart single-page README, add billing blurb, and draft email copy for beta testers (due 2026-06-24).
- Jin - Draft telemetry privacy note and share with legal/priv by 2026-06-23. Also add an opt-out flag for telemetry in sample CLI (due 2026-06-29).
- Priya - Update experiment dashboard to include the new funnel events and define baseline metrics for launch (due 2026-06-28).

6) Mini triage log (in-meeting)
- CI flake observed on macos-latest on sample suite: traced to flaky network port binding in playground harness. Short-term mitigation: randomize port range and add retry (Samir to patch, PR by 06/22).
- Quickstart local Dockerfile size: flagged by infra (image too big). María will try multi-stage builds and strip dev deps; target <350MB (due 06/29).

7) Risk register and rollback plan
- Risk: Beta quickstart increases support tickets if missing steps. Mitigation: enable opt-in, add in-doc troubleshooting snippet, and add a small banner in Console with link to support flow.
- Rollback: If first-week support load > 30 tickets or <50% success rate, revert flag and run a follow-up user test.

8) Parking lot / items for next meeting
- UX: propose a trimmed onboarding wizard in Console for quickstarts (Carlos from product wants to join next week).
- Samples: discuss refactor to share more code between sample templates to lower maintenance burden. Samir to prepare cost/benefit analysis.

9) Notes to self / informal observations
- Users care more about predictable output than absolute lowest latency; in early tests, a clearer example of the streaming fallback behavior reduced confusion.
- Keep PRs small and descriptive for quick review during the beta window.

10) Next meeting
- Date: 2026-06-28, same time. Agenda: pre-launch checklist for beta quickstart, Windows repro update, telemetry privacy response.

11) Quick links mentioned (copy for doc)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4321
- Linear: DEVEXP-87 (playground telemetry funnel)
- Confluence: Quickstarts Strategy (internal)
- Slack: #devexp-samples thread

-- end of notes --
